title: F20 · saying_no · Yes, Sure, No Problem
lines: It is nine at night. Everyone who asked has gone home.
She says yes because no feels like being a bad person.
Her own work has not been touched.
On the way out, she noticed the little Ganesha over the office door.
A child once told the most powerful being in the universe: not now.
Next morning: Can you just quickly...
Not today. I can on Thursday.
Your time is a door. You are allowed to guard it. That is sadhana.
